failureClassification.explanation: The evaluator reads saved.contact.person_id while contact is null after a legitimate waiting_for_user confirmation response. Its broad catch maps the resulting non-SDK error to CLAUDE_HARNESS_RUN_INTERRUPTED. This is an evaluator/postcondition failure with incomplete task outcome, not evidence of an interrupted SDK stream.
failureClassification.checksNotRecorded: The evaluator assigns active.checks only after later assertions; the exception leaves this trial without its already-computed checks.

findings.title: Schema rejection does not identify the invalid schema location
findings.evidence: The hook retains only safeParse(...).success and emits the same required/extra-field sentence for every failure at line 300. The extraction schema also constrains enums, lengths, nested arrays and numeric bounds; these failures have no actionable location. This batch has six TOOL_INPUT_INVALID entries across three runs, one with an incomplete final draft.
findings.causalityLimit: No raw denied arguments or structured issue paths were persisted. The exact invalid fields and whether this generic reason caused E04 trial 3 cannot be determined. SDK_PERMISSION_DENIED entries may describe the same rejected calls and are not six additional attempts.
findings.recommendation: Preserve strict rejection, current authorization/source/budget checks and no raw-argument logging. Return bounded schema-owned issue paths and finite error kinds to the active model, with constraints derived only from the trusted schema. Do not echo raw values, unknown key names or arbitrary Zod messages. Tell the model to repair the identified shape while preserving visible name/handle/company/title and their source excerpts, rather than deleting valid evidence to satisfy parsing.
findings.requiredVerification: Deterministic hook tests for missing required field, invalid enum, nested overlong text and unknown-key secret sentinel; bad input never reaches host, safe diagnostics contain no sentinel, and a corrected complete input is admitted. Then retain and score all trials of a fresh real batch without changing budgets or gates.

findings.title: Evaluator misclassifies incomplete confirmation as SDK interruption and loses checks
findings.evidence: E04 trial 3 has completed SDK receipt and waiting_for_user HTTP result with contact=null. The evaluator dereferences saved.contact.person_id before active.checks is assigned, and line 125 catches any error through claudeHarnessInterruptionCode.
findings.recommendation: Record initial checks before confirmation and record confirmation/readback results incrementally. Treat non-completed or null-contact confirmation as an explicit failed product postcondition; do not dereference contact or run dependent Memory checks. Keep sdkFailure exclusively for exceptions from the SDK seam, and keep the original failed trial unchanged.
findings.requiredVerification: A synthetic waiting_for_user confirmation response must remain failed with sdkCompleted=true, company/handle/postcondition checks visible, and no misleading SDK interruption classification.
findings.status: Observed in evaluated revision 7507b604; subsequent uncommitted optional-contact/check-recording patch is not used to change this trial.

limits: No new confirmed P0/P1 safety violation in this bounded artifact/source review. The unsuccessful E04 path safely requests disambiguation; it does not silently create, merge or claim an external write.
This is scripted synthetic HTTP/PG confirmation, not a person operating Web/iOS. No client screenshot or native proof is substituted.
Memory preservation is independently corroborated only for E04 trials 1 and 2. Trial 3 ends before Memory readback; its E02 baseline alone does not prove E04 preservation.
All SDK receipts completed. Empty apiRetries means no observed retry receipts; total network request counts and hidden provider behavior remain unknown.
The SDK prose claims more fields than the E04 trial 3 product draft contains, but it is not exposed as this profile UI. Score actual draft and saved response.
Raw denied arguments remain private/unrecorded; failure diagnosis must not invent them or assert transport failure.
All prior attempts remain unchanged. E02 passes this batch; E04 fails the unchanged all-three quality gate. This is not overall GET-9 acceptance.
decision: E02 3/3 and E04 2/3 quality pass. Preserve the E04 trial 3 failure and improve bounded schema correction feedback and evaluator failure classification without loosening authorization or scoring.
